text: The Patriots' secondary took another hit this week with starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck) ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Raiders, forcing the team to lean on depth options like newly-signed practice squad call-up Kindle Vildor. On the roster moves front, the Patriots placed veteran wide receiver Mack Hollins and fullback Reggie Gilliam on injured reserve while activating safety Brenden Schooler to the 53-man roster, a flurry of transactions that speaks to the depth challenges currently plaguing the squad. There's a silver lining, though: running back Rhamondre Stevenson returned to practice after missing time, providing some semblance of good news heading into a contest against a surprisingly red-hot Raiders team led by Kirk Cousins. To add a touch of pageantry amid the injury shuffle, the Patriots will wear throwback uniforms and honor Hall of Famer Adam Vinatieri during a halftime ceremony on Sunday, a moment of celebration that should provide a brief respite from what's been a trying week on the injury front.
